en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), and the Triplet on the Past Object (Atītārammaṇattika).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not having the past as its object, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and having the past as its object, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, with resistance, and not having the future as its object, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, without resistance, and having the future as its object, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not having a present object, there arises a dhamma that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and having a present object, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
